title: Human Anatomy IV
modules: The Tongue And The Sense Of Taste
The Nose And The Sense Of Smell

mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the image of a "pure" sound wave, but such a wave almost never exists in nature."
A smooth sigmoid curve is the image of a "pure" sound wave, but such a wave almost never exists in nature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a saucer shaped thin lamina of grey matter, lateral to the putamen."
The claustrum is a saucer shaped thin lamina of grey matter, lateral to the putamen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the final derivative of the neuroepithelial layer."
The ependymal layer is the final derivative of the neuroepithelial layer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered attractive, whereas acne is a source of embarrassment for many people."
Skin without blemishes is considered attractive, whereas acne is a source of embarrassment for many people.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the resonance quality or overtones of a sound."
Timbre is the resonance quality or overtones of a sound.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the obliquity of spinal nerve forming cauda equine and the formation of filum terminale."
Implication is the obliquity of spinal nerve forming cauda equine and the formation of filum terminale.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a group of structures found deep within the cerebral hemispheres."
The basal ganglia are a group of structures found deep within the cerebral hemispheres.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a thin membrane separating the external ear from the middle ear."
The tympanic membrane is a thin membrane separating the external ear from the middle ear.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an oval elevation on the posterior end of the pulvinar, receives fibres from the optic tract and projects to the visual cortex."
The lateral geniculate body is an oval elevation on the posterior end of the pulvinar, receives fibres from the optic tract and projects to the visual cortex.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the air-filled cavity of the middle ear."
Medial to the tympanic membrane is the air-filled cavity of the middle ear.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sterile procedure done to withdraw C.S.F. from the spinal subarachnoid space and must be performed well clear of the termination of the cord."
Lumbar puncture is a sterile procedure done to withdraw C.S.F. from the spinal subarachnoid space and must be performed well clear of the termination of the cord.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex process not simply confined to one type of input."
Balance is a complex process not simply confined to one type of input.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of two major tissue layers."
The skin is made up of two major tissue layers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very small plexus formed from the ventral rami of spinal nerve S5 and the coccygeal nerve (Co)."
The coccygeal plexus is a very small plexus formed from the ventral rami of spinal nerve S5 and the coccygeal nerve (Co).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the entire range of wavelengths, or frequencies, of electromagnetic radiation."
The electromagnetic spectrum is the entire range of wavelengths, or frequencies, of electromagnetic radiation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for colour vision and visual acuity."
Cones are responsible for colour vision and visual acuity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most complicated plexus, and other plexuses have similar, but simpler, interconnections."
Th e brachial plexus is the most complicated plexus, and other plexuses have similar, but simpler, interconnections.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a long cylindrical structure with flattened anterioposterior surfaces."
The spinal cord is a long cylindrical structure with flattened anterioposterior surfaces.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a function of the wave frequency."
The pitch of sound is a function of the wave frequency.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common cause of Parkinsonism."
The neurodegenerative condition Parkinson's disease is the most common cause of Parkinsonism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the final derivative of neuroepithelial cells."
Ependymal cells are the final derivative of neuroepithelial cells.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a function of the Schwann cells in the axons outside the SC while the portion within the SC is myelinated by oligodendrocyte."
Myelination is a function of the Schwann cells in the axons outside the SC while the portion within the SC is myelinated by oligodendrocyte.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most prominent commissural fibres collection."
The corpus callosum is the most prominent commissural fibres collection.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a similarly shaped but smaller set of membranous tunnels and chambers called the membranous labyrinth."
Inside the bony labyrinth is a similarly shaped but smaller set of membranous tunnels and chambers called the membranous labyrinth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a crenated C-shaped strip of gray matter with its open end facing the opposite cerebellar peduncle."
inferior olivary nucleus is a crenated C-shaped strip of gray matter with its open end facing the opposite cerebellar peduncle.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most prominent projection fibre."
The Internal capsule is the most prominent projection fibre.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an ectodermal derivative that begins to differentiate in the 3rd intrauterine week in humans."
The CNS is an ectodermal derivative that begins to differentiate in the 3rd intrauterine week in humans.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a white spot, the optic disc, through which the central retinal artery enters and the central retinal vein exits the eyeball."
Just medial to the macula is a white spot, the optic disc, through which the central retinal artery enters and the central retinal vein exits the eyeball.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the portion of the floor just behind the infundibulum."
The median eminence is the portion of the floor just behind the infundibulum.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the association visual area (Area 18 and 19)."
The striate cortex is the association visual area (Area 18 and 19).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that each side of the lens bulges outward."
Biconvex means that each side of the lens bulges outward.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered hormones because they are released into the general circulation and travel some distance to the tissues in which they have their effect."
Secretions of the adrenal medulla are considered hormones because they are released into the general circulation and travel some distance to the tissues in which they have their effect.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common disease involving dizziness from the inner ear."
Meniere disease is the most common disease involving dizziness from the inner ear.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of myelinated fibres, while cellular aggregates are in the gray matter."
White matter is a collection of myelinated fibres, while cellular aggregates are in the gray matter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the cervical (C1-C4), brachial (C5- T1), lumbar (L1-L4), sacral (L4-S4), and coccygeal (S5 and coccygeal nerve)."
The five major plexuses are the cervical (C1-C4), brachial (C5- T1), lumbar (L1-L4), sacral (L4-S4), and coccygeal (S5 and coccygeal nerve).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most easily damaged of all the peripheral nerves, but such damage is almost always temporary."
The ulnar nerve is the most easily damaged of all the peripheral nerves, but such damage is almost always temporary.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the part of the brain that most people think of when the term brain is mentioned."
The cerebrum is the part of the brain that most people think of when the term brain is mentioned.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the characteristics common to all mammals; if the hair is dense and covers most of the body surface, it is called fur."
The presence of hair is one of the characteristics common to all mammals; if the hair is dense and covers most of the body surface, it is called fur.

external ear
The external ear is the part extending from the outside of the head to the tympanic membrane, or eardrum.
______ is a contractile structure, consisting mainly of smooth muscle, surrounding an opening called the pupil.
iris
The iris is a contractile structure, consisting mainly of smooth muscle, surrounding an opening called the pupil.
______ is a thin, transparent mucous membrane.
conjunctiva
The conjunctiva is a thin, transparent mucous membrane.
______ is the most superficial layer of the skin; it consists of epithelial tissue.
epidermis
The epidermis is the most superficial layer of the skin; it consists of epithelial tissue.
______ is a branch of the facial nerve carrying taste impulses from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue.
chorda tympani
The chorda tympani is a branch of the facial nerve carrying taste impulses from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue.
______ is a hypotonic filtrate (lower osmotic pressure than a reference) of the blood that passes through the secretory cells of the sweat glands and is released by exocytosis.
Secretion commonly called sweat

______ is the removal of CSF from the subarachnoid space.
spinal tap
A spinal tap is the removal of CSF from the subarachnoid space.
______ are used to determine if the brainstem is functioning.
Brainstem reflexes
Brainstem reflexes are used to determine if the brainstem is functioning.
______ is the firm, opaque, white, outer layer of the posterior five- sixths of the eyeball.
sclera
The sclera is the firm, opaque, white, outer layer of the posterior five- sixths of the eyeball.
______ is a structural connection between the diencephalon and the spinal cord.
Brain Stem
The Brain Stem is a structural connection between the diencephalon and the spinal cord.
______ is the sulcus that separates the frontal from the temporal lobe.
Lateral sulcus (fissure of Sylvius)
Lateral sulcus
Lateral sulcus (fissure of Sylvius) is the sulcus that separates the frontal from the temporal lobe.
______ is the inferior lip of the postcentral gyrus.
Gustatory area
Gustatory area is the inferior lip of the postcentral gyrus.

Human Anatomy (IV)
Human Anatomy
IV

______ is the fleshy part of the external ear on the outside of the head.
auricle
The auricle is the fleshy part of the external ear on the outside of the head.
______ is an abnormal increase in intraocular pressure that results when the rate of production of aqueous humour exceeds its rate of removal.
Glaucoma
Glaucoma is an abnormal increase in intraocular pressure that results when the rate of production of aqueous humour exceeds its rate of removal.
______ are the most important elements of the focusing system of the eye.
cornea and lens
The cornea and lens are the most important elements of the focusing system of the eye.
______ is a place where the image passing through the focusing system can be clearly seen.
Past the focal point
Past the focal point is a place where the image passing through the focusing system can be clearly seen.
______ is responsible for most of the refraction of light entering the eye.
cornea
The cornea is responsible for most of the refraction of light entering the eye.
______ means straight, and the fibers of these muscles are nearly straight with the anterior-posterior axis of the eyeball.
Rectus
Rectus means straight, and the fibers of these muscles are nearly straight with the anterior-posterior axis of the eyeball.
______ are a function of skeletal muscles.
Movements of the eyelids
Movements of the eyelids are a function of skeletal muscles.

Taste preference simply
Taste preference simply means that an animal will choose certain types of food in preference to others, and the animal automatically uses this to help control the diet it eats.
______ are responsible for non - colour vision and vision under conditions of reduced light.
Rods
Rods are responsible for non - colour vision and vision under conditions of reduced light.
______ is a very contagious skin condition.
Scabies
Scabies is a very contagious skin condition.
______ is a set of fluid-filled chambers medial to the middle ear.
inner ear
The inner ear is a set of fluid-filled chambers medial to the middle ear.
______ is the bent portion of the internal capsule.
Genu
Genu is the bent portion of the internal capsule.
______ is a complex network of neuron cell bodies and axons within the wall of the digestive tract.
enteric nervous system
The enteric nervous system is a complex network of neuron cell bodies and axons within the wall of the digestive tract.
______ are the axillary, radial, musculocutaneous, ulnar, and median nerves.
five major nerves
The five major nerves are the axillary, radial, musculocutaneous, ulnar, and median nerves.
______ is responsible for most of the structural strength of the skin.
dermis
The dermis is responsible for most of the structural strength of the skin.
______ is a relatively small plexus originating from spinal nerves C1-C4.
cervical plexus
The cervical plexus is a relatively small plexus originating from spinal nerves C1-C4.

pulvinar
The pulvinar is the posterior end of the medial surface of the thalamus.

The lens is an avascular, transparent, biconvex disk located behind the pupil.
______ is the inner layer of the eye, covering the inner surface of the eye posterior to the ciliary body.
retina
The retina is the inner layer of the eye, covering the inner surface of the eye posterior to the ciliary body.
______ is an air-filled chamber medial to the tympanic membrane.
middle ear
The middle ear is an air-filled chamber medial to the tympanic membrane.

Smell
Smell is the least understood of our senses.
______ is the posterior end of the superior and middle temporal gyri and the lower part of the parietal lobe.

Posterior speech area
Posterior speech area (Wernicke) is the posterior end of the superior and middle temporal gyri and the lower part of the parietal lobe.

dermatome
